name: hyperframes
description: Write a HyperFrames HTML composition and render it to MP4. The tab shows when heygen-com/hyperframes has a newer release.

tools.name: hyperframes.updates
tools.description: Compare the last seen HyperFrames release with the current npm version and GitHub main commit.

tools.name: hyperframes.write
tools.description: Save a HyperFrames HTML composition in the session workspace.

tools.name: hyperframes.render
tools.description: Render a saved composition to MP4 with the hyperframes CLI. Needs Node 22, FFmpeg and Chrome.
